description: This header file declares functions and structures related to managing server connections, including pool management, cleanup, shutdown, and connection acceptance.

methods.name: connections_pool_clear
methods.description: Clears the pool of server connections, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: connection_graceful_shutdown_maint
methods.description: Performs maintenance to shutdown connections gracefully.

methods.name: connection_periodic_maint
methods.description: Performs periodic maintenance tasks on server connections.

methods.name: connection_accepted
methods.description: Handles the acceptance of a new connection from a server socket.

methods.name: connection_state_machine
methods.description: Manages the state transitions for a connection.
